badges.name: First Quest
badges.prompt:
Create ONE finished collectible achievement badge icon for a Grade 5 English learning game. Square image 1024x1024. Consistent mascot duo: a friendly cream-colored tabby cat with teal scarf and a cheerful orange fox with white muzzle and navy neckerchief. Both are equally visible in every badge, cute expressive chibi storybook characters with polished dimensional digital illustration, crisp silhouette and bold simple shapes readable at 96px. A circular enamel medallion with substantial gold rim, subtle embossed details, centered and fully inside frame with 8% padding, plain warm ivory background outside circle. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark. Child-friendly confident joyful mood. 
Badge theme: First Quest. Scene: The cat and fox are beginner adventurers stepping together onto a tiny path, holding a glowing golden star and a rolled treasure map. Emerald meadow medallion interior, small backpack, celebrate their first completed adventure.
